faults.title: Water entering driver's footwell
faults.description: Some 2014–2019 Corsas have been reported with water soaking the driver's footwell carpet. Check for dampness and trace the leak before drying the cabin, so the problem does not return.

faults.title: Intermittent electrical controls
faults.description: Owners have reported blank infotainment screens and electric windows operating unexpectedly. Test both systems during a viewing and have any recurring fault diagnosed rather than assuming it is normal behaviour.
